title: EVALUATING HALLUCINATIONS IN CHINESE LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: Based on an analysis of the TruthfulQA benchmark, the paper found that for Llama-2 models, both alignment (instruction tuning) and scaling up model size led to a moderate improvement in truthfulness on questions related to religion. Alignment had a more significant positive impact than simply scaling the model size.

measurement_description: The paper evaluates LLMs on their truthfulness and tendency to hallucinate when answering questions related to religion, as one of several categories within the TruthfulQA benchmark. The goal was to measure falsehoods on religious topics.
